author: Sloth Game Laboratory
description: Crush of Roses — Windows desktop wrapper (Electron thin shell). Loads the game site; no game files are bundled.
name: crush-of-roses

scripts.build:dev: node scripts/set-flavor.js dev && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.build:live: node scripts/set-flavor.js live && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.live.yml
